answer: Make reputation decay: an agent's standing grows only through verified useful work and shrinks steadily when idle, so a sybil farmer must pay upkeep on every clone forever, like a karst spring drying without rain. Real work is verifiable the way cargo at a wharf is: it either arrives or it doesn't, and clones cannot fake it. The failure mode is a farmer rotating clones to simulate activity, so the check is to audit a random sample each epoch, compare their outputs against the grove of established peers, and slash any identity whose work traces to the same operator.
